title: Daily Signal Brief No. 024 — Council vote today, Ashby ships consent, Mobley docket holds
summary: Three signals, all narrowing rather than opening. (1) L3 — The Council of the EU is scheduled to formally adopt the Digital Omnibus on AI today, 26 June 2026; the 16-month deferral of Annex III HR/employment obligations from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027 takes its first procedural step, with signature by Presidents and Official Journal publication still ahead before entry into force (target adoption before 2 August 2026). Council vote was scheduled-for-today at brief window-close, not yet verified-as-landed; Eglin owes a verified call by Monday 14:00Z. Forge + Helm's Friday EOD file / do-not-file on the Annex III consultation: file regardless, with headline framing pivoted to match landed-vs-slipped outcome. (2) L2 — Ashby shipped AI Notetaker opt-in recording-consent customization this week (dynamic-filter location-based override rules, EU-region opt-in with opt-out default elsewhere, candidate application-form opt-in question stored on profile, centralized admin view, GDPR + EU-US DPF certified). Third MCP-lane vendor in 30 days to ship region-aware compliance affordances after Workable (5/13) and Greenhouse (6/25). Compass's Friday narrative-shift piece names the three-vendor pattern and frames eval-set v1.2 publish as the methodology-publication differentiation the rest do not have. (3) L2 watch — Mobley v. Workday post-22-June-order docket: Judge Lin's verbatim 'directly liable for its own engagement in FEHA-regulated activities on the employer's behalf' and 'designed, developed, maintained, and controlled from California headquarters' passages now in Duane Morris + HR Executive + HR Dive trade-press primary record; Compass can quote verbatim Friday. Second plaintiffs'-firm filing not yet observed; DOJ-OLC 9 June memo on EEOC disparate-impact guidance explains EEOC silence and reaffirms California-FEHA + state-AEDT as operative private-action vector. O-2 advance: regulatory-deferral arm tracked through first procedural-loop closure; three-vendor MCP-lane consent pattern named explicitly; Mobley verbatim quote availability closes 6/25 source-confidence caveat.
